faqs.a:
(a)
Application requirements.
An applicant seeking financial assistance through the rebate program shall submit
               a completed application, meet all the requirements set forth in the application, provide
               any documents required by the director to support the application, and satisfy any
               other requirements established by the director.
(b)
Application submission.
An applicant must submit an application by a deadline established by the director
               in a format determined to be appropriate by the director.
(c)
Application changes.
In the event the applicant's information changes while an application is pending,
               the applicant must notify the director of the changes.
(
Ord. No. 4887
, § 1, 1-27-2025)
